findings.reason: The initial observation mapping accepted unknown keys, so caller-supplied message or credential text could enter through an unobserved field even though the report projection was bounded. The mapping is now closed and a canary regression proves the report refuses without echoing the value.

The initial pure core checked only that workspace_id was non-empty. A new explicit workspace_roots observation now refuses a missing or foreign workspace binding, and multi-root observations are refused as foreign rather than merged.

The approval row named a private planning file in the public product queue. The row now references only the public package contract; the private authorization remains in MyWork and is not copied into the product tree.
Ruff E9/F found an unused hashlib import in the initial module implementation; it was removed before the recorded green run.
